title: Deutsche OCR-Sonderzeichen-Referenz
description: Additive synthetic reference for German special characters, Unicode case forms, currency and unit characters, German authority terms, and fictional names. Printed with the bundled Noto Sans Regular (OFL) embedded as a Type0/CIDFontType2 font so U+1E9E (ẞ) is a real glyph and the text layer is character-faithful.

rights.legalBasis: project-generated fictional content; bundled font Noto Sans under SIL Open Font License 1.1
rights.notes: All authorities, names, values, and addresses are invented. The document carries a visible synthetic marker on every page.

generator.notes: No randomness, wall clock, locale, or network input. Fixed object order, fixed document id, un-compressed streams, whole font embedded verbatim (no subsetting).

rawText.cer: Levenshtein distance over aligned character pairs divided by the ground-truth code-point count; unaligned ground-truth characters are deletions, unaligned OCR characters are insertions
rawText.lineAssociation: A ground-truth line and an OCR line belong together when the OCR line vertical centre lies inside the ground-truth line box grown by 4 pt and the horizontal overlap covers at least 30 % of the narrower box. Association is geometry only and never uses text similarity.
rawText.specialCharacterPrecisionRecall: Computed from the edit-distance alignment over the required character set only; precision = correctly kept required characters / all required characters produced by OCR, recall = correctly kept required characters / all required characters in the ground truth. The confusion matrix counts every aligned ground-truth-to-OCR pair whose source is a required character, plus missing-position deletions.

matchingAliases: ä↔ae, ö↔oe, ü↔ue, ß↔ss (matching only, never for raw text)
noSilentCorrection: ocr-confusion StraBe for Straße is never rewritten to ß
Grosse for Größe is never rewritten and never counted as a match
missing umlaut dots are reported, not repaired
a missing or ambiguous label stays unresolved and is never converted into a forced type
semantic.fieldDetection: contracts/recognition-output.md §3.2 via the production TypeInference label-proximity rule; a field counts as detected only when a credible label is assigned and the label text matches after the declared matching aliases
semantic.labelGeometry: IoU between the assigned OCR label rectangle and the ground-truth label rectangle

metricsPolicy.unresolved: An unresolved case is reported as UNRESOLVED and never as an accuracy PASS. Critical lines must match exactly on the clean reference variant or be listed as explicitly unresolved with the observed difference.

evidenceClasses.EMULATOR: production raster port (PDFium/pdfrx) plus production bundled ML Kit OCR on the emulator; the only class that can satisfy a device gate for the clean reference variant
evidenceClasses.EMULATOR_INJECTED_RASTER: production bundled ML Kit OCR on the emulator over a raster degraded outside the production raster path (scan photo simulation); never reported as clean production-path evidence
evidenceClasses.TEXT_LAYER: PDF text layer (pdftotext); control path proving the printed code points, never OCR evidence

variants.description: Clean reference render at the fixed 200 DPI analysis scale over the production raster and OCR ports; this is the reference variant for both raw text and semantic assignment.
Raw OCR capture at 150 DPI through the production raster and OCR ports. The semantic pipeline keeps its fixed 200 DPI analysis raster, so this variant qualifies the DPI effect on raw text only.
Raw OCR capture at 300 DPI through the production raster and OCR ports. The semantic pipeline keeps its fixed 200 DPI analysis raster, so this variant qualifies the DPI effect on raw text only.
150 DPI scan with reduced contrast and a light gray wash.
200 DPI scan with a soft page shadow in one corner.
200 DPI scan rotated by three degrees about the page centre on a white background.
200 DPI scan compressed as a low-quality JPEG and decoded back to gray8.
